full_judgment: against the respondent No. 1 Shahida Begum and the Ministry of Works for declaration of title and recovery of khas possession on the basis purchase from original allottee Md. Haiti f after the property was released as an abandoned property. The point for consideration was that whether the Shahida Begum respondent No. 1 having purchased the suit property before it was released from the category of abandoned property, acquired any title to the suit property and whether she also succeeded in proving her possession. From the evidence on record the High Court Division found that the respondent No. 1 succeed in proving that her sale deed dated 16.07.19981 was executed and registered by Md. Hanif i.e. the original owner. There was no clause in the lease deed dated 18.05.1962 in favour Md. Hanif making it a condition precedent for obtaining permission to effect the sale of the suit property by Md. Hanif, there is a bar for such transfer under article 6 of the President Order No. 16 of 1972 if such property was abandoned one. The High Court Division after consideration of provision of article 6 correctly found that the sale of an abandoned property will be treated as null and void and the purchaser will not acquire any title. But this bar will not apply in respect of any property if it is ultimately found to have been declared/ taken over as an abandoned property wrongly or by mistake. In the instant case the admitted position that the government acting through the Ministry of public work having considered all aspects of the case released the suit property in favour of Md. Han if vide release order dated 11.11.1981 since the suit property was not an abandoned property in law and therefore sale deed dated 16.07.1981 executed and registered in favour of respondent No. 1 Shahida Begum by Md. Hanif had conferred title to Shahida Begum in respect of the suit property. Consequently the predecessor of the petitioner Maharam Ali Master had acquired no right, title and interest of the suit property on the basis of sufficient sale deed dated 15.05.1982. Because Hanif had no title to the suit land on that date to transfer in favour of Maharam Master as title to the suit property was already transferred by him to respondent Shahida Begum by sale deed dated 16.07.1981.
